capabilities: Create links from selection or clipboard
Convert links between wikilink, markdown, autolink, and HTML formats
Unlink or delete links, including links in headings
Edit, set, copy, and cut link text and destinations
Embed or unembed files via links
disambiguation: Not about backlinks or the graph; it edits link syntax in the editor.
extras: The README references many demo videos/GIFs for each feature that are not present in the plain-text version; settings options are described inline per feature.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in commands for converting between link formats or editing, deleting, and unlinking links in place.
summary: Link manipulation toolkit that creates, converts, edits, copies, and deletes wikilinks, markdown links, autolinks, HTML links, and URLs.
